Name: OpenXLR
Description: Control the OpenXLR daemon: hardware DSP toggles, mix and channel faders on dials, mutes with live state on the keys, soundboard clips.
Author: Emanuele Sparvoli

Actions.Name: Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle hardware, microphone EQ or a band; cycle an EQ type; control mix and channel mutes or plugin bypass

Actions.Name: Clip
Actions.Tooltip: Play a soundboard clip into SFX, or stop every clip

Actions.Name: Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Adjust channel sends, mix masters, gain, headphones, crossfade, microphone EQ bands or plugin controls
